About

Built by a creator, for creators.

God's Favour Emmanuel Founder & Growth Strategist, Avenro

Avenro was founded by God's Favour Emmanuel to close the gap between good content and the audience it deserves. I've sat on both sides of the growth problem, as a creator trying to get discovered, and as a strategist helping others do the same.

Today Avenro works hands-on with streamers, indie developers, SaaS founders, and brands who are ready to grow but don't have the time or team to chase every channel themselves. Every engagement starts the same way: an honest look at what's actually working, and a plan built around the platforms that matter to you.

There's no dashboard full of vanity metrics here, and no agency-speak. Just one person who does the actual work, stays reachable through it, and treats your channel or product like it's their own reputation on the line, because it is.

Get in touch

Who I work best with

Streamers & creators

Twitch, Kick, and YouTube creators with content worth watching who need the right people to actually find it.

Indie game developers

Small studios and solo devs who need visibility around a launch or update without a full-time marketing hire.

SaaS founders

Early and growth-stage products that need consistent, credible reach instead of a one-off marketing sprint.

Brands

Brands looking to show up authentically in creator and gaming spaces instead of running another generic ad.

How I work

Every outreach message is personal and sent to creators who actually fit, never a mass blast.
No viewbotting, fake followers, or paid non-genuine engagement, ever, on any platform.
You see the work as it happens: screenshots and updates, not just a summary at the end.
I guarantee the effort, not a number I can't control. Results depend on real audience interest.
